checks.name: new_results_persist_as_v2_only
checks.detail: Persistence accepts historical archives but validates current payloads and prevents new micom_v1 provenance.

checks.name: native_workflow_exposes_truthful_confirmation
checks.detail: The native MGA workflow requests the coupled methods, requires the configural review, and no longer carries the withdrawn disclosure.

checks.name: v2_contract_is_documented
checks.detail: MICOM v2 documentation states equations, hierarchy, bounded scope, and independent evidence requirements.

checks.name: micom_v1_withdrawal_is_preserved

note: A passing audit qualifies only the bounded MICOM v2 contract. It never restores the withdrawn micom_v1 claim, and packaged-desktop release evidence remains a separate gate.
